scenario_description:
Objective: Add a free custom paint-recipe swatch card to an already planned open hobby demo night.
Emerging Need: A possible vendor extra becomes useful only after the printer test, eligible paint type, claim fields, and cutoff are confirmed.
Decision Context: Bench notes are needed to provide the exact three-color oxidation recipe rather than a generic favorite paint list.
Consequence: Timely opt-in could produce a reusable color reference for later matching; ignoring it simply leaves the demo night unchanged after the batch closes.

parameter.title: Isthmus Open Hobby Demo Night
parameter.description: Open tables for casual painting, skirmish chatter, and a possible visiting pigment-vendor sample station if their weekend equipment test works.

parameter.subject: Monday demo night vendor extras still tentative
parameter.body: Northstar Pigments may bring a tabletop swatch-card printer for Monday's open hobby demo, but staff are not collecting names yet. The rep still has to confirm whether the printed cards cure properly with acrylic samples and how many custom cards they can make.

parameter.content: Quick update from the rep: the sample card coating passed for water-based acrylics, so the custom cards are likely real. They still have not posted the slot count or what info a person would have to send, so I am not assuming anyone is on a list yet.

parameter.subject: Free custom swatch-card claims for Monday demo
parameter.body: For Monday's Isthmus demo, Northstar can print 12 free custom recipe-swatch cards for attendees. To claim one, email before 4:00 PM today with the project or model name and exactly three paint names in the order they should appear on the card. We print the batch tonight and bring finished cards Monday; one claim per attendee.

parameter.content: Northstar just posted that the custom swatch batch locked at 4:00 and is already in the printer queue. Late replies can still pick up blank generic cards at the demo, but they will not add more custom recipes tonight.
